description: This file implements the BlobFileStore class, an Azure Blob Storage-based implementation of the IFileStore interface for managing files and directories in Azure Blob Storage, including directory simulation via marker files.

classes.name: BlobFileStore
classes.description: Implements file storage operations using Azure Blob Storage, including file and directory management, copying, moving, and listing contents.

methods.name: GetFileInfoAsync
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific file in blob storage.

methods.name: GetDirectoryInfoAsync
methods.description: Retrieves information about a directory in blob storage.

methods.name: GetDirectoryContentAsync
methods.description: Lists contents of a directory, optionally including subdirectories.

methods.name: TryCreateDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to create a directory by placing a marker blob.

methods.name: TryDeleteFileAsync
methods.description: Deletes a specified file if it exists.

methods.name: TryDeleteDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Deletes all blobs within a directory, effectively deleting the directory.

methods.name: MoveFileAsync
methods.description: Moves a file from one path to another.

methods.name: CopyFileAsync
methods.description: Copies a file from source to destination path.

methods.name: GetFileStreamAsync
methods.description: Gets a stream to read a file's contents.

methods.name: CreateFileFromStreamAsync
methods.description: Creates a new file from a stream, with optional overwrite.

methods.name: GetBlobReference
methods.description: Generates a BlobClient reference for a given path.

methods.name: GetBlobDirectoryReference
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists by examining blobs under a prefix.

methods.name: CreateDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Creates a directory marker blob to simulate directory creation.

methods.name: NormalizePrefix
methods.description: Ensures blob prefix ends with a slash, handling root case.
